fileSurface.surface:
One-shot CLI poll of the demo feedback inbox — the reprogrammable
surface is the CLI contract only: filter flags (--last, --since) and
their semantics, stdout JSON formatting, and validation/exit messages.
NL-driven change accepts none of: network fetch (disk read only, C9),
drift of the {round, approveAll, verdicts, receivedAt} entry schema
shared with POST /demo/feedback, or watcher/daemon modes (one-shot by
design). node:fs only; no other imports.
NLCL linkage: no action in control/action-catalog.v1.json v7 targets
this file yet — actionIds stays empty until one is catalogued.
